messages:
sarah_cs: Heads up — MiraHealth onboarding: we're seeing ~20% p99 latency spikes during 8–10am window, CPU+GPU both okay but tail tokens blow up. Proactive idea: try int8 quant + swap to compact-llama-13b-int8 for burst traffic, and set routing to spill non-critical requests to eu-west as fallback. @miguel_infra can you validate quality impact? :eyes:
miguel_infra: on it. quick A/B canary makes sense. I want to run 1% traffic to compact-llama-13b-int8 for 24h, keep sample prompts for eval. Can you send sample prompt set?
sarah_cs: dropping sample prompts now (DM'd). also thinking prefix-KV cache config tweak: increase prefix_keep to 512 for session-heavy flows.
miguel_infra: noted. proposed canary config:
```
route: mirahealth_canary
model: compact-llama-13b-int8
traffic_split: 1
autoscale: min=1,max=3
log_level: debug
```
will run in staging then mirror to prod.
opsbot: [deploy-bot] Canary deployment mirahealth_canary started by miguel_infra at 5897654330. status: initializing.
ken_platform: FYI — check routing policy priority, we should set fallback to eu-west with cost-aware tag so billing isn't surprising. add `cost_limit: 0.75` in policy.
miguel_infra: good call. I'll add cost_limit and an emergency fallback to base-llama-13b if compact underperforms.
olivia_re: quick renewal note — MiraHealth flagged tail latency as a concern in renewal survey. If we can show 15% cost reduction + stable p99 next week, that helps the renewal convo. Can we aim for a preliminary report by Tue?
sarah_cs: yes — Aim: canary results + latency/cost delta by Tuesday EOD. I'll schedule a brief sync with MiraHealth and pull usage trends. @olivia_re I'll send the draft report for renewal talking points. :thumbsup:
miguel_infra: running canary now. will post quality diffs and per-route latency histograms to this thread.
opsbot: [metric-alert] MiraHealth p99 decreased 12% in canary mirror at 5897654385.
